say:2:1220419001:1.text: Honored guests, what do you wish to buy? I have everything you need!
say:2:1220419001:1.source_cn: 诸位，诸位要买点什么？我这里什么都可以有！

say:3:1220419002:1.text: "Anything" sounds pretty good! Do you have any healing potions?
say:3:1220419002:1.source_cn: “什么都可以有”？太好了，有没有治疗药剂？

say:4:1220419003:1.text: There are no finished products, only raw ingredients... but you can use them to brew potions; you really can get anything you need!
say:4:1220419003:1.source_cn: 没有成品，只有原材料……但您可以用这些原料调配炼金药剂...

say:5:1220419004:1.text: A bit of alchemy? That's a job for the Magister!
say:5:1220419004:1.male: A bit of alchemy? That's a job for the Magister!
say:5:1220419004:1.female: A bit of alchemy? That's a job for the Magister!
